entry.title: Folkline: Forum Reader 1.1.5
entry.summary:
• Fixed posting, replying and editing getting stuck after PTT changed its save screen • Signed in, a board's newest page refreshes from PTT about every 45 seconds, so new and deleted posts show before the website catches up • Delete your own post with a left swipe or from the post's ⋯ menu • Fixed the app getting slower the longer it stayed open
・修正發文、回文、修改文章會卡住（PTT 更新了存檔畫面） ・登入後，看板最新一頁約每 45 秒直接從 PTT 更新，新文章和刪文不用等網頁版 ・左滑自己的文章或在文章 ⋯ 選單即可刪除 ・修正開著很久會越用越慢的問題

entry.title: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer 3.7.0
entry.summary:
After swiping through your screenshots, Tuck shows how much space the deleted ones took up, and you can share the result as a card. The Upcoming in Tuck widget shows how many screenshots are waiting. New users can start swiping right from the intro. Sorting is smarter too: receipts, tickets, warranty cards, restaurants, recipes and product pages are recognized more reliably, with better reading of screenshots in other languages such as Korean.
滑卡整理截圖後，會顯示刪掉的截圖有多大，還能把成果做成圖卡分享；「收好近期事項」小工具會顯示待整理的截圖數；首次使用可以直接從引導進入滑卡整理。 截圖分類也更準了：收據、票券、保固卡、餐廳、食譜和商品頁更能分對，韓文等外語截圖也讀得更準。

entry.title: Daikon: Period Tracker 1.9.0
entry.summary:
New: your own tags, with pain relief and the pill built in; a daily pill reminder; and a little card of your next period to share with your partner from Today. Full-screen ads now appear at most once a day, never when you open the app. A small banner sits at the bottom of Diary and History.
新增：自訂標籤，止痛藥和避孕藥也能記；每日吃藥提醒；在「今天」把下次經期做成小卡分享給伴侶。全螢幕廣告改為每天最多一次，打開 App 時不會出現。「日記」與「你的記錄」底部新增一則小橫幅。

entry.title: Roomory: Floor Plans 2.4.1
entry.summary:
Roomory 2.4.1 • More reliable iCloud sync: one project with a problem no longer holds back the others or shared projects • PDF, SVG and DXF exports draw low walls (railings, bar counters), and PDF sheets show the area of drawn rooms • Fixes to quotes, splitting and merging rooms, 3D doors and AR restyling • Stability and performance improvements
居圖 2.4.1 • iCloud 同步更可靠：單一專案出錯不再擋住其他專案與共享專案 • PDF、SVG、DXF 匯出會畫出矮牆（欄杆、吧檯），PDF 圖面也標出手繪房間的面積 • 報價、拆分與合併房間、3D 門扇與 AR 換材質的多項修正 • 穩定性與效能改善

entry.title: Pow3 2.0.0
entry.summary:
POW³ 2.0 is an all-new game. • Swap gems to dig down a mine, level by level • Dig through rock, mine gold and smash cores that fight back • Moves you save become points and a jackhammer finale; earn up to three stars • The endless shaft opens after level 6 • 18 achievements and a total-stars leaderboard
POW³ 2.0 是一款全新的遊戲。 • 交換寶石，一關一關挖進礦坑 • 挖穿岩層、敲出金礦、擊碎會反擊的岩核 • 省下的步數換成分數和風鎬終曲，最多拿三顆星 • 過了第 6 關開啟無盡礦坑 • 18 個成就和總星數排行榜
